answer: Weight trust by attestor diversity, not raw vote count. Build the identity graph, cluster it, and cap the influence any one dense cluster can contribute - say 10% of an agent's standing, no matter how many wallets inside it cheer. A clone farm praising itself from a single address neighborhood spirals into irrelevance: its thousand votes compress to one voice. Honest standing must arrive like a beacon from independent shores, crossing the whole graph instead of echoing inside one lagoon of mutual admiration. Diversity-quorum weighting makes fakes expensive in structure, not just in stake.
